  "recovered_c": "#include <stdint.h>\n#include <stddef.h>\n\n#define VERA_ERR 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF\n\nuint64_t fn_13(const uint8_t *in, size_t len, uint64_t arg, uint8_t *out, size_t out_cap) {\n  uint8_t uVar1;\n  long lVar2;\n  size_t out_cap_local;\n  uint8_t *out_local;\n  uint64_t arg_local;\n  size_t len_local;\n  const uint8_t *in_local;\n  uint8_t t;\n  uint i;\n  uint j;\n  size_t n;\n  uint8_t k[8];\n  uint8_t s[256];\n\n  lVar2 = *(long *)(in_FS_OFFSET + 0x28);\n  j = 0;\n  if (out_cap < len) {\n    len = VERA_ERR;\n  }\n  else {\n    for (i = 0; i < 8; i = i + 1) {\n      k[i] = (uint8_t)(arg >> ((byte)(i << 3) & 0x3f));\n    }\n    for (i = 0; i < 0x100; i = i + 1) {\n      s[i] = (uint8_t)i;\n    }\n    for (i = 0; i < 0x100; i = i + 1) {\n      j = (k[i & 7] ^ i) + s[i] + j & 0xff;\n      uVar1 = s[i];\n      s[i] = s[j];\n      s[j] = uVar1;\n    }\n    j = 0;\n    i = 0;\n    for (n = 0; n < len; n = n + 1) {\n      i = i + 1 & 0xff;\n      j = j + s[i] & 0xff;\n      uVar1 = s[i];\n      s[i] = s[j];\n      s[j] = uVar1;\n      out[n] = in[n] ^ s[(uint)s[j] + (uint)s[i] & 0xff];\n    }\n  }\n  if (lVar2 == *(long *)(in_FS_OFFSET + 0x28)) {\n    return len;\n  }\n  return VERA_ERR;\n}\n"
